name: Sean Catalfamo
summary: Sean Catalfamo is a yacht and car broker in Miami who reached out on 2026-10-28 after his Snapchat account (username sean.catalfamo) was locked for a 'Prohibited Substances' community guidelines violation he believes was a false report. He had already filed an appeal (under review, up to 30 days) before contacting Derrek, and then discovered he was device-banned when trying to create a new account. Derrek told him Snapchat unbans are essentially impossible and there is nothing anyone can do; no service was sold. Sean is still hoping the appeal succeeds and may follow up asking for a 'higher up' contact.
key_facts: Lock reason: Community Guidelines violation for Prohibited Substances (email dated 2026-10-28, 1:58 AM)
Sean already submitted an appeal before reaching out; Snapchat confirmed it is under review (up to 30 days)
Derrek advised: never appeal from now on; appealing likely hurt his chances
Device ban triggered when he tried to create a new account; Derrek explained fully disabled accounts chain-ban new accounts on the same device
Outcome: Derrek said no Snapchat unbans are possible, nothing anybody can do; no price quoted, no sale
Sean is a yacht and car broker in Miami; Snapchat is his main client marketing channel
Sean wants to contact Snap reps himself and asked if Derrek has a higher-up connect
